<think>**Planning 32-bit Kogge-Stone adder implementation**

**Designing parameterized prefix adder modules**

**Estimating timing improvement from prefix adder**

</think>

{
  "candidate_rtl": "module cla32 (
    input  wire [31:0] x,
    input  wire [31:0] z,
    output wire [31:0] sum
);
    wire [31:0] g0;
    wire [31:0] p0;
    wire [31:0] g1;
    wire [31:0] p1;
    wire [31:0] g2;
    wire [31:0] p2;
    wire [31:0] g3;
    wire [31:0] p3;
    wire [31:0] g4;
    wire [31:0] p4;
    wire [31:0] g5;
    wire [31:0] p5;
    wire [32:0] carry;

    assign g0 = x & z;
    assign p0 = x ^ z;

    genvar i;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < 32; i = i + 1) begin : gen_prefix
            if (i == 0) begin
                assign g1[i] = g0[i];
                assign p1[i] = p0[i];
            end else begin
                assign g1[i] = g0[i] | p0[i] & g0[i-1];
                assign p1[i] = p0[i] & p0[i-1];
            end

            if (i < 2) begin
                assign g2[i] = g1[i];
                assign p2[i] = p1[i];
            end else begin
                assign g2[i] = g1[i] | p1[i] & g1[i-2];
                assign p2[i] = p1[i] & p1[i-2];
            end

            if (i < 4) begin
                assign g3[i] = g2[i];
                assign p3[i] = p2[i];
            end else begin
                assign g3[i] = g2[i] | p2[i] & g2[i-4];
                assign p3[i] = p2[i] & p2[i-4];
            end

            if (i < 8) begin
                assign g4[i] = g3[i];
                assign p4[i] = p3[i];
            end else begin
                assign g4[i] = g3[i] | p3[i] & g3[i-8];
                assign p4[i] = p3[i] & p3[i-8];
            end

            if (i < 16) begin
                assign g5[i] = g4[i];
                assign p5[i] = p4[i];
            end else begin
                assign g5[i] = g4[i] | p4[i] & g4[i-16];
                assign p5[i] = p4[i] & p4[i-16];
            end
        end
    endgenerate

    assign carry[0] = 1'b0;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < 32; i = i + 1) begin : gen_sum
            assign carry[i+1] = g5[i] | (p5[i] & carry[0]);
            assign sum[i] = p0[i] ^ carry[i];
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule

module timing_adder (
    input  wire        clk,
    input  wire        rst_n,
    input  wire [31:0] a,
    input  wire [31:0] b,
    input  wire [31:0] c,
    output reg  [31:0] y
);
    reg [31:0] sum1;
    reg [31:0] sum2;
    wire [31:0] next_sum1;
    wire [31:0] next_sum2;

    cla32 add_ab (
        .x(a),
        .z(b),
        .sum(next_sum1)
    );

    cla32 add_sum_c (
        .x(sum1),
        .z(c),
        .sum(next_sum2)
    );

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            sum1 <= 32'b0;
            sum2 <= 32'b0;
            y    <= 32'b0;
        end else begin
            sum1 <= next_sum1;
            sum2 <= next_sum2;
            y    <= sum2;
        end
    end
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The reported b[0] to flip-flop path is dominated by the synthesized 32-bit ripple-style a+b carry chain, containing approximately 17 carry-related majority and AOI stages before the endpoint flop.",
  "rewrite": "Replace both inferred arithmetic operators with explicit 32-bit parallel-prefix carry networks. The rewrite computes carries in five logarithmic prefix stages rather than allowing synthesis to form a serial carry chain, while retaining the original three-register pipeline and nonblocking assignment ordering.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected critical-path improvement is approximately 2.0 to 4.0 ns in this library if the prefix structure is preserved by synthesis, potentially increasing WNS from 1.38 ns to roughly 3.4 to 5.4 ns. Exact gain requires rerunning synthesis and STA; mapping may partially collapse or restructure the prefix logic.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Likely area increase of approximately 20% to 60% for the adder logic, plus increased routing congestion and switching activity from the prefix wiring. The second adder is also rewritten, so non-critical sum1-to-sum2 logic may incur additional area. No additional registers, latency, reset logic, or clocking resources are added.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Ports, active-low asynchronous reset behavior, register reset values, three-cycle input-to-output pipeline behavior, 32-bit modulo-2^32 arithmetic, and cycle-by-cycle output semantics are unchanged. The prefix carry network uses an explicit zero carry-in, exactly matching ordinary unsigned Verilog addition for 32-bit results."
}
